q: A 28-year-old woman at 30 weeks with respiratory physiology presents with normal pregnancy shows a chronic compensated respiratory alkalosis, with pco2 28-32 mmhg, hco3 18-22. opts: Compensated respiratory alkalosis: pCO2 28-32, HCO3 18-22, pH 7.40-7.45
Uncompensated metabolic acidosis: pCO2 45-50, HCO3 12-16, pH 7.20-7.28
Acute respiratory acidosis: pCO2 55-60, HCO3 26-30, pH 7.22-7.30
Metabolic alkalosis with hypokalaemia: pCO2 45-50, HCO3 32-36, pH 7.50-7.55
